facts.fact: Yes, a learner's licence requires passing the online test (STALL test)
facts.quote: Yes, you have to pass the online test (STALL Test) to get Learner's License.

facts.fact: Sample questions for the test are on Sarathi (Learner License menu)
facts.quote: You can practice (sample set of questions) here:- 1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ 2. Select concerned state 3. Select "Sample Question for Learners' License Test" from "Learner License" menu

facts.fact: For the test, the applicant reports to the concerned RTO or its authorised learner's licence test centre
facts.quote: Can I give exam from home or I will have to go to the concerned RTO? You need to report the concerned RTO or their authorized learning license test center.

summary: STALL test, sample questions on Sarathi and reporting to the RTO/authorised LL test centre all confirmed on the Parivahan FAQ; expected answer unchanged.
